transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Well, I came in because people have started noticing how I'm moving lately. Um, sometimes it's like I'm moving underwater. It just takes me forever to answer someone or even get out of a chair. 

But then other times, it's the exact opposite. I'll just be pacing around my apartment, rubbing my hands together like I'm trying to shake off a bad call from work. So... yeah, it's getting pretty obvious, and that's mainly why I'm here.
Have you been hearing or seeing things that other people don’t?

Yeah, I actually have. Um... it's mostly hearing things, not really seeing them. Sometimes I'll hear the beep from my old work headset, or... or I'll hear a voice that sounds like a supervisor. It'll just say my name, or tell me I'm being too slow. The weird part is, it happens when my laptop is completely closed and there's no phone ringing at all. So, yeah, I've definitely been hearing that.
Have you had a period where you felt unusually high, euphoric, or unusually irritable?
No, not really. I haven't had anything like that. I just feel mostly down, or, you know, just kind of slow like I said. But never really high or super energetic or anything.
Have you been feeling depressed most of the day, nearly every day?

Um, honestly, no. I wouldn't say I feel depressed most of the day or every day. I mean, I definitely feel down sometimes, like I mentioned, and just really drained or slow. But it's not this constant, heavy sadness all day long. It's more just... feeling flat or worn out, I guess. So, no, not depressed nearly every day.
Have there been times when your body stays fixed in one position for a long time, even when you want to move?

Not exactly fixed in one position where I can't move, but... well, when I get really overwhelmed, I do sort of get stuck. Like, I'll catch myself just standing in the kitchen with my coffee mug halfway to my mouth, just frozen there for a minute. Or sometimes I'll realize I've been walking the same little loop around the couch over and over for no real reason. So I guess I do get stuck or do weird repetitive things, but I can move if I really try to snap out of it.
Have you been diagnosed with any brain or neurologic illness?
No, I haven't. I've never had any kind of brain illness or neurological diagnosis or anything like that. Just the stuff I've been telling you about.
Did these problems start soon after you began using any drug or after any recent medical illness?
No, not at all. I don't really use drugs, and I haven't been sick with anything medical recently. These things just kind of started on their own, not after anything specific like that.
Do people ever have trouble understanding you because your speech becomes hard to follow or jumps from one idea to another?

No, I don't think so. I mean, sometimes I might lose my train of thought if I'm feeling really down or distracted, but people usually understand what I'm saying. I don't think I jump around so much that it confuses anyone. I just talk normally, for the most part.
Have other people told you that your face looks blank or that you show very little emotion?

Yeah, they have. My friends have mentioned that I sound pretty flat and that I'm hard to read now. I guess even when I really care about what they’re saying, I don't show it much on my face. I mostly just give them short answers, and... I just kind of avoid making plans with them lately.
